title: docs: close out Phase 0 with the real baseline numbers

body:

## How this was verified

- `docs/README.md` internal links: 0 broken (script check)
- CI green on the base commit 610df85: Pint 31 files, PHPStan no errors, Pest 14 passed (26 assertions)
